items.text:
GREEN SPOON FOOD TRUCK — WEEKLY SPECIALS
North Quad, beside Kessler Library
Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM

MONDAY — BURRITO DAY
Black bean burrito with lime rice: $6.50
Grilled chicken, added: $2.00
Mango salsa cup: $1.75

WEDNESDAY — NOODLE BOWL
Sesame noodle bowl with seasonal vegetables: $7.25
Extra tofu: $1.50
Ginger iced tea: $2.25

FRIDAY — BREAKFAST ALL DAY
Buttermilk pancake stack with maple syrup: $5.75
Two scrambled eggs: $2.50
Cold brew coffee: $3.00

Every order of $10.00 or more earns a free side salad. Students who show a valid campus ID receive 10% off the noodle bowl before 12:00 PM. Preorder through the campus dining portal to skip the line. We accept dining dollars, debit cards, and mobile pay; cash is not accepted. On rainy days, service moves to the covered walkway outside Baker Hall. Follow @greenspoontruck for daily updates.

questions.stem: According to the menu, what does a customer receive at no charge?

options.A: A side salad with a purchase of ten dollars or more
options.B: A ginger iced tea with any noodle bowl order
options.C: A mango salsa cup with any burrito order
options.D: A cold brew coffee with any breakfast order

questions.explanation: The menu states that every order of $10.00 or more earns a free side salad, while the other items listed carry individual prices.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about customers who order at the Green Spoon truck?

options.A: Customers who pay with cash receive a small discount.
options.B: Customers can avoid standing in line by ordering ahead online.
options.C: Customers who use the dining portal pay less for a burrito.
options.D: Customers can buy the pancake stack on Monday and Friday.

questions.explanation: The menu tells customers to preorder through the campus dining portal to skip the line, which implies that ordering in advance avoids a wait.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the 10% noodle bowl discount?

options.A: It applies to drinks as well as to main dishes.
options.B: It cannot be applied to an order placed after noon.
options.C: It requires payment by mobile app rather than by card.
options.D: It is offered on days when the truck moves to the walkway.

questions.explanation: The discount applies to the noodle bowl only before 12:00 PM, so an order placed after that time would not qualify.
